texts.preamble: Mahmad Salim Ansari vs Mehsana Nagarpalika on 7 June, 2023 Author: Sangeeta K. Vishen Bench: Sangeeta K. Vishen C/Sca/7566/2023 Order
texts.arguments: ORAL ORDER Mr Dhaval M. Barot, learned advocate for the petitioners states that the subject matter of challenge, is the order dated 10.02.2023 which, has been passed on the premise that the petitioners, are not possessing licenses under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Gujarat Shops and Establishment (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 2019. To which, Mr Kamlesh S. Kotai, learned advocate for the respondent - Nagarpalika states that if application is made by the petitioners with requisite documents, the respondent shall take a decision Mahmad Salim Ansari vs Mehsana Nagarpalika on 7 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96103792/ 1 in accordance with law.
